look: Abyssal Tidewyrm, a S-rank GKOM variant from the Tide Wisps family: sea serpent of black water coiled around a crimson orb. Family anatomy: living water: wisps, water maidens and serpents of black lake water. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: a near-complete GKOM crystal hide with thin bare seams; the crystals are pearl-white tide crystal. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, dramatic sweeping ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
